abi: plan.h frozen; all 11 extern imports and their signatures unchanged from inputs/host.goose; no heap or runtime allocations added; build/link/execution left to parent

issues.description: The intermediate mul node (packet arg second) was never type-checked in mode 5. It is correctly used only structurally (other(second,node), other(third,second)) and its data is rightly not required (fused intermediate may have data=NULL), but native still asserts its type metadata, which the host skipped.

issues.native_reference: CONTRACT: 'Validate intermediate/root types and shapes without touching absent intermediate storage.'
issues.description: Shapes of fused intermediate nodes were never validated: dims of the rms_norm node (node) were not compared with X dims for modes 3/4/5, and dims of the mode-5 mul node were not compared with X dims. ti(...,3,i)/ti(...,2,...) read only ne/type metadata and never touch absent storage, so the required validation was safely expressible but missing.

issues.native_reference: CONTRACT: 'all pointer arithmetic must remain in checked address span'; tensor ti key 9 is 'ggml_nbytes(t) checked span (must call)'.
issues.description: The required span call ti(t,9,0) was executed but its value was discarded, and extent accumulation was incomplete: nothing verified that the projected byte extent 4+sum((ne[i]-1)*nb[i]) (exactly ggml_nbytes for F32 with nb0==4) fits the span, nor that the accumulation itself cannot wrap u64 before the device computes row*stride style offsets. Corrupt or wrapped geometry would have launched.

fixes: H1: added ensure(ti(second,2,0)==f32_type(),23) for mode 5 before any launch effect.

H2: added dims(node)==dims(X) check (fail code 22) for modes 3/4/5 and dims(second)==dims(X) (fail code 24) plus F32 type (fail code 23) for the mode-5 mul node, reading only ti type/ne metadata so absent intermediate storage is never touched or required.

H3: copy_tensor now accumulates ext = 4 + sum((ne[i]-1)*nb[i]) using the existing overflow-checked mul() plus a new checked add() (overflow fail code 26), then requires ext <= ti(t,9,0) with a positive span (fail code 25). For any consistent F32 tensor this is an identity (ggml_nbytes == 4 + sum((ne[i]-1)*nb[i])), so valid native configurations are never rejected; it rejects only corrupt metadata or spans whose u64 offset arithmetic could wrap on the device. ti(t,9,0) is still called exactly once per projected tensor.
intentional_safety_repairs: Kept from the supplied draft (native is looser; contract mandates stricter): mode 1 requires contiguous X and D although native group_norm flat-indexes without any assert; dims(D)==dims(X) enforced for every mode including the mode-4 scale tensor and the mode-3/5 fused outputs although native never checks destination shape (strided-reference semantics require it); mode 6 requires dims(grad)==dims(X); null or unrelated M/A operands are rejected before any stream/kernel effect although native silently falls back to unfused RMS when mul_t==nullptr; all dims bounded to (0,INT32_MAX] and every product guarded via mul()/ensure because native int truncation would be UB.
New in this revision: intermediate-node type/shape validation (fail codes 22-24) and checked-extent-versus-span verification (fail codes 25/26) as described in fixes.
No native-valid configuration is rejected by the new checks: dims equalities hold for any well-formed fused graph, and the extent check is a mathematical identity for consistent F32 tensors.
remaining_contract_questions: Assumes ti(t,9,0) returns ggml_nbytes(t) as i64 (parallel to key 1 returning the data pointer). If the bridge instead returns only a status code, fail-code-25 comparison must be dropped; everything else is unaffected.

iv14 shared bytes for mode 6 kept at 256 when bs>32 per CONTRACT ('shared bytes256 for norm/back/group') and because device block_pair writes 2 floats per warp into the dynamic buffer, while native rms_norm_back passes 0 dynamic shared bytes (uses static __shared__ float[32] x2).

Mode 1 with groups>channels: native launches groups*samples blocks and excess blocks idle; host preserves this native behavior (no artificial reject) since size/total/groups are guarded and overall work is not silently zero.

Mode 4 scale value (float op_params[0] of second) is forwarded unconstrained (zero/negative allowed per contract tests); only bias op_params[1]!=0 is rejected; eps keeps the native eps>=0 assert, so NaN eps is rejected.
Data NaN/Inf policy: the host never inspects tensor contents; the special NaN comparison policy for exact-value testing is a parent fixture concern per contract.

coverage.mode_2_rms_norm: plain RMS: vector policy below, scalar bs 256/1024, shared 128 when bs>32, iv6/iv7 written
coverage.mode_3_rms_norm_fused: M=other(second,node) with null/unrelated rejection (codes 20/8/7), D=second, iv8, per-dim magic for M (flat words 0..11), vec additionally requires M.ncols==ncols and 16B alignment, intermediate node type and shape validated (10/22)
coverage.mode_4_rms_norm_scale_fused: second.src0==node and float op_params[1]==0 enforced (11), D=second, fv1=scale (zero/negative allowed), iv10, no M/A, vec identical to native do_scale path, intermediate node shape validated
coverage.mode_5_rms_norm_fused_add: M from second via other(second,node), A=other(third,second), D=third, iv8/iv9, magic for M and A (words 0..11 and 12..23), vec requires both ncols equality and alignment, mul-node F32 type and shape validated (23/24), node shape validated (22)
coverage.mode_6_rms_norm_back: grad=node.src[0] (contiguous enforced), X=node.src[1], dims X==D and grad==X, nr=rows*channels*samples mul-guarded <=INT32_MAX, grid [nr,1,1], bs 32/1024 by cols, shared 256 when bs>32
coverage.mode_7_l2_norm: same grid/bs as norm, shared 128 when bs>32; scale=rsqrt(max(sum,eps*eps)) lives on device
coverage.vector_policy: vec = ncols%4==0 && data pointers and nb[1..3] of X and D 16-byte aligned; M/A additionally require ncols==X.ncols and 16-byte alignment; n4=ncols/4 thresholds 32/128/256/512/1024 -> bs 32/128/256/512/1024 vpt1, n4<=4096 -> bs1024 vpt4, n4>4096 -> scalar bs1024; exact match with rms_norm_f32_dispatch and ggml_cuda_is_aligned
coverage.plan_writes: key0 ptrs X/D/M/A/Grad; key1 dims [which*4+i]; key2 strides in float elements; iv0..17 all written per contract (15/16/17 group-only, 6/7 RMS-only, 8/9/10 fusion flags); fv0 eps, fv1 output scale; key4 magic flat three words per dimension matching init_fastdiv_values and device modulo coefficient keys
coverage.validation_order: all rejections happen before launch(packet); no stream or kernel effects on failure; no silent zero-work launches (grids >= 1x1x1 for all modes)
coverage.syntax: only constructs demonstrably present in input Goose files (let/var, while, if-else expressions, as-casts including call-result and parenthesized-arith casts, u64/i64/f32/bool literals, extern fn declarations)
